selection: lowest validation accuracy MAE; ties use grid order
fusion: concatenate train-standardized blocks; divide each block by sqrt(width), then multiply all features by sqrt(2048)
scorer: same multioutput ridge for all variants
reference: reference_text only; pinned CMUdict unnumbered entry; unknown words flagged, no corpus-phone fallback
ipa_ablation: each nonempty embedding subset with and without fixed IPA diagnostic block; IPA-only control
interpretation: validation screening, not independent test or SOTA evidence; pretrained-source overlap unverified
